disposition_summary: Decision Rule B (240 speakers/stratum = 1,440 total across 6 strata) is INFEASIBLE across all candidate open corpora combined. Mozilla Common Voice 27 has 0 unexposed strictly eligible Irish speakers remaining. Edinburgh Accent Corpus (EdAcc) contains only 104 speakers worldwide across 40 accents (at most 3-4 Irish speakers). VoxCeleb lacks verbatim ground-truth transcripts and validated accent labels, rendering it methodologically inadmissible for confirmatory ASR evaluation under Protocol v1.4.0. Across all candidates, the maximum identifiable unexposed Irish pool is only 15 speakers (shortfall: 225 speakers). Furthermore, any uncrossed patchwork creates mathematically collinear corpus-by-accent confounding (Rank(X) < p), and downsampling to N_g <= 40 causes joint statistical power to drop below the mandatory 90% threshold.

design_confounding_analysis.mathematical_collinearity_explanation: When an accent stratum is populated from only one corpus while other strata are populated from different corpora, the linear mixed model design matrix X is rank-deficient: col(X_accent) intersects col(X_corpus). The expected WER contrast between accents is E[y_i - y_i'] = (alpha_i - alpha_i') + (gamma_j - gamma_j'). The acoustic differences (microphone, noise, codec, compression) cannot be distinguished from algorithmic adaptation.

formal_recommendations: Do NOT proceed with Cohort 3 audio download or physical materialization under Decision Rule B.
Do NOT attempt confirmatory materialization from Common Voice 27 alone (Irish unexposed capacity = 0).
Do NOT adopt an uncrossed patchwork (e.g. Irish only from OpenSLR/EdAcc, Australia only from AusTalk), as accent and corpus effects become mathematically collinear and non-identifiable.
Do NOT ingest VoxCeleb without ground-truth verbatim transcripts and verified dialect tags.
Do NOT silently downsample to N_g <= 40 without supervisory approval, as joint power drops to ~71% (violating the 90% threshold).
Formally present this feasibility audit to the research supervisor to adopt one of the documented strategic academic decision pathways.
